svg.title: Democrat Scott Colom wins Mississippi Senate race
svg.desc: Editorial illustration. At night, election workers at a long lamplit table check stacks of absentee and affidavit ballot envelopes while a colleague carries in another tray. Behind them the Mississippi State Capitol, with its dome, lantern and gilded eagle, glows in front of a giant magnolia blossom opening like a sunrise. It represents the days-long count that ended on Nov. 11, 2026, when Democrat Scott Colom was projected to have defeated Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith.
